instruction: Align the table on Page 3 to the right edge of the slide.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires aligning the table on slide 3 to the right edge of the slide. Slide width is 9144000, table width is 7886520, so right-aligned position would be left=9144000-7886520-200000=1057480 (with margin). The evaluator checks if the table left position is between 900000 and 1300000. Verified by analyzing the PPTX structure.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks horizontal position (left property) for right-alignment verification
Metric function properly extracts shape position from PPTX file using python-pptx library
Slide index (2) correctly maps to Page 3 (0-indexed)

Minor issue: No explicit validation that the shape at index 2 is a table type (only checks position)
Expected value range (900000-1300000) provides reasonable tolerance for 'right edge' alignment based on calculated position
